malayalam:
[സംഗീതം]
ആദ്യമേ തന്നെ പരിശുദ്ധ അമ്മ മാതാവിനോടും
തിരുക്കുമാരനോടും ഞാൻ നന്ദി പറയുന്നു
കാരണം ഞാൻ ഇതിനു മുന്നേ വന്ന്
തൊഴുതിട്ടുണ്ട് ഉടമ്പടി ഒന്നും
എടുത്തിട്ടില്ല ഞാൻ കൊല്ലം ചവറയിൽ നിന്നാ
വരുന്നത് ഞാൻ അമ്പലത്തിൽ നാസനം
വായിക്കുന്ന ക്ഷേത്രജീവനത്തിലാ അപ്പോൊ
അതുകാരണം ഉടമ്പടി എടുക്കാതിരുന്നത്
ഓരോരുത്തര ഓരോന്ന് പറഞ്ഞ് അങ്ങനെ
നമ്മളങ്ങ് വിശ്വസിച്ചു പക്ഷെ
മാസത്തൊഴിയിലിന് വരുമായിരുന്നു പിന്നെ
എന്റെ അപ്പുറത്തുള്ള ഒരു ചേച്ചിയാണ് എന്റെ
അടുത്ത് പറഞ്ഞത് ഉടമ്പടി എടുക്കുന്നതിന്റെ
കാര്യങ്ങളൊക്കെ പറഞ്ഞ് അങ്ങനെയാണ് അപ്പ
ഇപ്പോ എന്റെ മോളുടെ കാര്യം പറയാനാണ് ഞാൻ
ഇവിടെ വന്നത് കാരണം എന്റെ മോൾക്ക്
ഉടമ്പടിയിൽ ഞാൻ പക്ഷെ അങ്ങനെയുള്ള
ഇതൊന്നും പറഞ്ഞിട്ടൊന്നുമില്ല
സമ്പാദ്യത്തിന്റെ കാര്യം അങ്ങനെഒന്നും
പറഞ്ഞില്ല ഒരു മാതാവിനോടുള്ള ഒരു ഇഷ്ടം
കൂടിയാണ് ഞാൻ ഉടമ്പടി എടുക്കാൻ കാര്യം
അപ്പോ ഉടമ്പടിയുടെ ക്ലാസ്സ് കേട്ടപ്പോഴാണ്
മനസ്സിലായത് അങ്ങനെയുള്ള ദൈവത്തിൽ
അങ്ങനെയുള്ള കാര്യങ്ങളൊന്നുമില്ല.
എല്ലാവർക്കും ഉടമ്പടി എടുക്കാം എന്നുള്ളത്
മനസ്സിലായത് അങ്ങനെയാ. ഇപ്പോൊ ഞാൻ
വന്നഎന്ന് വെച്ചാൽ എന്റെ പൊന്നു മോളുടെ

അവൾക്ക് 12 വയസ്സാണ്.
ഞങ്ങൾ ഇപ്പോൾ ഈ അടുത്ത ഇടയഇറക്കിയപ്പോ ഒരു

First of all, I thank the Blessed Mother Mary and the Holy Son Jesus.
Because I had come here to pray before, but I had not taken any Covenant, and I come from Chavara in Kollam.
I work in a Hindu temple playing the Nadaswaram, and that was the reason I initially hesitated to take the Covenant.
People used to say various negative things and I believed them, but I still faithfully came for the monthly prayers.
Then a sister living nearby told me about the blessings of taking the Covenant, and that is how I learned about it.
Today I have come here to testify about my daughter, because when I took the Covenant, I didn't ask for worldly things.
I didn't ask for financial prosperity or savings, but I took the Covenant purely out of my deep devotion for the Blessed Mother.
It was only after attending the Covenant class that I truly understood the boundless nature of God.
That is how I understood that anyone can enter into the Covenant, and now I am here to share what happened to my precious daughter.
My daughter's name is Sarayu. She is twelve years old.
About a month ago, she started experiencing severe pain inside her ear.
Because of the pain, we thought it might be earwax, so we checked inside using a cotton bud.
When we checked with the bud, there was blood on it, so I assumed it was just a small boil.
Boils are common for everyone, so thinking it was just a boil, I ignored it for a couple of days.
A few days later, her pain increased significantly and it started bleeding again, which is why we took her to a nearby hospital.
At the hospital, they also said it was just earwax, and they gave us ear drops to clear the ear canal.
We applied the medicine for two days to remove the earwax, but by the second night, her condition worsened.
That night, she experienced excruciating pain, and it felt as if a growth was protruding from inside her ear.
I was absolutely terrified, and I rushed her immediately to the doctor.
When we went there, they told us that the ear canal had completely closed up, but they still insisted it was just earwax.
They sent us back home, and the very next day, my daughter had her school exams going on.
Even with all that agony, my daughter insisted on going for her exam, though I repeatedly told her to stay home.
She wouldn't listen and said she absolutely had to write her exam, so she went to school.
While at school, her teacher saw blood continuously oozing from her ear, and the teacher was deeply frightened.
Because she was bleeding heavily, the teacher herself advised us to take her to KERF, a famous hospital in Kollam.
We went to that hospital, consulted the doctor, and after examining her, he suggested taking an endoscopy.
They performed the endoscopy, and as the camera went inside, they noticed a heavy obstruction.
The doctor then told us that they could see something resembling a fleshy mass growing inside.
He suggested doing an HRCT scan to investigate further, and the scan revealed a mass growing downwards.
They couldn't determine if the growth was extending from the brain or from the side, but they said she needed immediate surgery.
They also said it was mandatory to send the sample for a biopsy, and to tell you the truth, my heart broke.
She is a child I was blessed with after four and a half years of waiting and making many vows, and while we can endure our own suffering, it is unbearable when it strikes our children.
I felt completely helpless, and I was on the verge of losing my mind out of sheer agony.
Even when I go to work at the temple, I have never missed my intercessory prayers to the Blessed Mother.
Whether it was early or late, I never skipped my prayers, and I always participated in the priest's online prayers.
For four days, I kept sending continuous prayer requests through messages during the early morning prayers.
The day before yesterday, we were supposed to admit her to the hospital, so I called this retreat center in distress.
I didn't know if the person who answered the phone was a sister or someone else, but as soon as they answered, I wailed aloud.
I cried bitterly calling out, 'Sister, my daughter is going in for surgery, and I urgently need the priest's intercession.'
I was speaking frantically because the mere mention of the word 'biopsy' had completely devastated my spirit.
When I explained this the day before yesterday, the sister on the phone asked me if I had taken the Covenant.
I said I had taken the Covenant, and then the sister reassured me, saying not to fear anything and to hold onto the Medal of the Blessed Mother.
She said, 'Go with the Covenant Medal and continuously recite the Apostles' Creed, and she will return safely without any complications.'
In my desperation, I called out to the Blessed Mother and pleaded with her with a heavy and broken heart. Do you know what I told Mother?
I told her that if anything happened to my child, I wouldn't be able to bear seeing her endure such agonizing pain.
I couldn't bear to see my daughter's physical state deteriorate, so I passionately interceded before Mother Mary and Jesus.
I prayed that if any tragedy struck, I would rather end my life right then and there alongside my daughter.
I wept and prayed, 'Mother Mary, I will not return alive, and I will not let my daughter become a slave to this suffering.'
Taking that strong vow, I left for the hospital, and day and night, I was immersed in deep intercessory prayer.
After the evening prayers, I gave my daughter blessed honey and blessed salt, and I faithfully anointed her with the Covenant Oil.
Empowered by all these blessings and clinging to my faith in the Blessed Mother, I went to the hospital yesterday and got her admitted.
By the evening, the nurses came and took my daughter away for her medical tests.
My daughter will explain the rest, because I was resting in the upstairs room in the hospital with my younger child since she was asleep.
Her father was also with us, and so was our younger daughter.
So, it was her father who accompanied her downstairs with the sisters for the blood tests and to check her medications.
My daughter will now share the rest of the details. "My name is Sarayu, and I am twelve years old.
I am studying in the sixth standard, and when I went for my medical checkup, I consulted a doctor named Joshna.
The doctor told us that since my surgery was scheduled for the next day, my ear had to be cleaned first.
So, they sent me to another room to get my ear cleaned, but while cleaning it, the male nurse felt something was unusual.
Because he had a doubt, he performed an endoscopy, and when he checked again with the camera, there was absolutely nothing in my ear.
He was completely shocked and frightened by this, so he immediately called Dr. Joshna.
Dr. Joshna came and examined my ear, but she couldn't find anything either, so they took me to the chief doctor, Dr. Sunil.
Dr. Sunil also examined me thoroughly, but he couldn't see any growth, and he declared that a great miracle had happened.
He said that no surgery was required anymore, because my ear was completely healed on its own.
He added that if we had any further concerns, we could do another scan by the end of April just to be sure.
Right now, I have no problems at all; they did an endoscopy and just placed some medicine in my ear.
They gave us some medicine and sent us home. Honestly, no matter how much gratitude I express to the Lord Almighty and the Blessed Mother, it will never be enough.
My heart overflows with gratitude, for I hold the Blessed Mother as closely as my own flesh-and-blood mother.
For years, Mother Mary has been my very life, and when it comes to our children, every parent treasures them more than anything else.
We can endure any pain that comes our way, but when our children suffer, it feels worse than death.
We were living through a nightmare, counting every agonizing hour, but when the doctor shared the miraculous news yesterday, I was overwhelmed.
I didn't know what to do, but I offer millions of praises to Mother Mary, and I surrender my entire life at her holy feet.
I am completely out of words to describe the boundless grace of our Blessed Mother. My dear Mother.
As an act of mercy, I recall a time when we saw a pregnant girl stranded without a vehicle on the highway.
Her mother-in-law stopped us and tearfully begged us to take the girl to the hospital.
Seeing her tears, we immediately turned our vehicle around and took the young woman to Victoria Hospital.
Because of my job playing the Nadaswaram, I don't always have the time or resources to do large acts of charity.
We don't have much free time, but I always try to do whatever small acts of kindness I can.
My daughter and I also distribute the newsletters; we give them to the local daily-wage workers through my aunt.
I thank the Blessed Mother for everything; no matter how much I praise her, it will never be enough.
A million praises to you, Mother. As it says in Psalm 107, verses 13,
"Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them from their distress;
he brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and burst their bonds apart."
This sister, Indulekha, her daughter Sarayu, and their entire family stand before the Blessed Mother with hearts full of immense gratitude.
They are offering their tearful love at her holy altar, giving thanks for the great blessing they received and for being made living witnesses to her powerful intercession.
We have just heard through the words of this mother and daughter about the terrifying ordeal their family faced in recent days.
They were told that a flesh-like mass was growing inside the daughter's ear, requiring immediate surgery and a biopsy.
The initial scans brought very distressing news to the family, causing them immense anxiety and sorrow.
Yet, this mother’s life beautifully illustrates how closely one can hold the Covenant to their heart.
Even while working a temple job playing the Nadaswaram, which requires late-night and early-morning duties.
She never deviated from her daily Covenant commitments, faithfully participating in the morning and evening prayers.
The family joyfully engaged in listening to testimonies, attending retreats, and diligently following every practice of the Covenant.
The youngest child standing at this altar leads the family's prayers by reciting the Apostles' Creed entirely from memory, as shared in the testimony tent.
To that extent, even the little children in the family have learned the Apparition prayer and the Apostles' Creed by heart.
Surrendering themselves completely to the Mother, anointing themselves with the Covenant oil, and relying on the Mother's protection,
they led their lives forward every single day, which is beautifully marked here.
When they cried out for intercessory prayer in terrible anxiety, bearing the full burden and sorrow of the moment doctors advised the operation,
a message was conveyed to pray to the Mother of Hope using the Covenant medal and Holy Oil.
Yesterday, when admitted to the hospital for the operation and undergoing final checkups,
it was discovered that without even a trace of the flesh left, the daughter had received complete healing, which is testified at this altar.
Beyond medicine and medical science, by the power of God, any tribulation and sickness in life can be completely healed.
God's power is able to give us new joy, and Jesus and Mother Mary specifically help us with this through the Covenant.
For the new hope, immense joy, and the miraculous healing received in this family,
let us thank Mother Mary and her Divine Son, clapping our hands as we offer this testimony.
